body: The App won’t get past the “Import from Socials” page. All text doesn’t not fit on the screen either

title: Subscription???
body: I really like the idea of the app but u need to pay 40$ a year, I really do not wanna spend money on an app in which I am gonna import TikTok’s for the rest of time. Maybe start adding some advertising.

title: Not bad. Needs work.
body: It’s a really good idea. But a really small pool of recipes. When I try to get a different recipe for one day it only changes between a few. The UI could use a bit of work too.

title: One of the best meal planning apps!!
body: I actually love this app so much. It changed the game for me when grocery shopping as someone who doesn’t have a lot of time too cook but loves buying enough food to feed a whole family. It makes everything extremely easy to follow and gives you a ton of options to choose from!!

title: Changed the game for me and my bf!!!
body: Me and my bf recently moved in together so adjusting to cooking for him too was alottt and I was so disorganized until I found this !! I’m so happy it’s available with US options now! Literally saves us so much time and money!! Definitely recommend
